steps.say: A funnel narrows a whole market down to a short list, by itself. | It starts from a pool, such as the top five hundred coins, and checks them in stages, from the daily chart down to the hour.
Funnels live in Angstrom Lattice. | Angstrom provides four to start from: crypto and equities, longs and shorts.
Each stage checks one Set, at each close of its own timeframe. | Only the assets that hold every stage before it are checked at the next one.
A provided funnel can't be changed. | Press Make my own copy, and your copy runs for your account, every hour.

In your copy, choose the pool: the top fifty, a minimum daily volume, or just your watchlist. | By default an asset leaves a stage only after two No answers in a row, so it doesn't flicker in and out.
Under Stages, your Sets sit on the left, as in Prism Scan. | Drag one onto a stage, or press plus to add a stage, and pick when each stage is checked.
Flagged means every stage holds but the last: it's on the shortlist. | Candidate means every stage holds. | Pending means data was missing, so it waits.
Your funnel shows up on the dashboard: as Dynamic funnel above the crypto and equity tables, and as a tile in Quick Snapshot. | Turn on alerts to hear about new Candidates.
